meta.name: customer-success-management
meta.description: Runs the ongoing relationship with accounts after the sale — segmenting coverage against account value, building a health score that predicts rather than describes, running reviews customers find worth attending, forecasting renewals honestly, and finding expansion that follows usage instead of quota. Use this to design a customer success motion, decide who gets a named contact, work out why renewals surprise you, or fix a health score everyone ignores.

copy.tagline: 设计客户成功机制，预测续约并发现增购机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责客户成功，想让续约不再意外、健康评分真正有用。
copy.tagline_en: Design a customer success strategy to forecast renewals and find expansion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead customer success and need honest renewal forecasts and credible health scores.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按该技能顾问式地处理客户成功管理:按客户价值做分层覆盖、构建经过结果校验的健康分、设计客户愿意参加的复盘、分阶段预测续约、依据使用情况找扩展机会。
howto.when: 当用户请它设计客户成功流程、决定哪些客户配专人、排查续约意外、或修复没人信的健康分时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计客户成功分层覆盖方案
say.note: Claude 会按客户价值和复杂度分配覆盖方式。

say.text: 如何构建能预测流失的健康分?
say.note: Claude 会建议从已流失/续约客户倒推差异指标。

say.text: 客户只有我们一个联系人,有风险吗?
say.note: Claude 会指出这是单线程风险,应列入可处理项。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will act as a customer-success advisor: segment accounts by value for coverage, build health scores validated against outcomes, run reviews customers attend, forecast renewals in stages, and find expansion from usage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks it to design a customer success motion, decide who gets named coverage, diagnose renewal surprises, or fix a health score no one trusts.

say_en.text: Help me design segmented coverage for customer success.
say_en.note: Claude will assign named, pooled, or programmatic coverage by account value.

say_en.text: How do I build a health score that predicts churn?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest working backward from churned vs renewed accounts.

say_en.text: We have only one contact at this account. Is that a risk?
say_en.note: Claude will flag it as single-threading and treat it as actionable.
